Incorrect: The full interruption test is the most thorough test but also the most disruptive. During a parallel test, the team actually activates the disaster recovery site for testing but the primary site remains operational.
Incorrect: During a tabletop exercise, team members come together and walk through a scenario without making any changes to information systems.

Incorrect: The checklist review is the least disruptive type of disaster recovery test. During a checklist review, team members each review the contents of their disaster recovery checklists on their own and suggest any necessary changes.
